_comment: North Dakota 2027 Allocation Plan, NDHFA. Competitive scoring is Section 7, Project Ratings (PDF pp.13-17). Page numbers are PDF page indices; the printed page numbers run 7 lower. The plan states no overall maximum, only a 55-point eligibility floor, so the computed total of 99 is ours and not the document's.

track_totals.note: The plan states no maximum score. Section 7 sets a floor instead: 'Applications for an allocation of competitive 9% LIHTCs must receive a minimum of 55 points as determined by the Agency to be eligible for further consideration.' Summing every criterion's maximum gives 105, but categories H, I and J cannot be combined with K, so the most a project can actually earn is 99.

groups.label: Housing for Older Persons against rent rebate, tenant ownership and family housing
groups.source_quote: are not eligible for points under this scoring category
groups.note: Categories H (2), I (2) and J (5) each state that an application seeking points under K, Housing for Older Persons, is not eligible for them. So a project takes either K alone (6) or any combination of H, I and J (up to 9). Modelled as a capped sum of 9, which is the larger of the two routes; max_one would understate it as 6.

criteria.heading: Serves lowest income groups
criteria.quote: Points will be awarded to projects with a minimum percentage of units having gross rents based upon 50%

tiers.tier_label: 30% or less AMI: 50%+ of total units
30% or less AMI: 40%<50% of total units
30% or less AMI: 30%<40% of total units
30% or less AMI: 20%<30% of total units
30% or less AMI: 10%<20% of total units
40% AMI: 20%+ of total units
40% AMI: 10%<20% of total units
40% AMI: 5%<10% of total units
40% AMI: 1%<5% of total units
50% AMI: 20%+ of total units
50% AMI: 10%<20% of total units
50% AMI: 5%<10% of total units
50% AMI: 1%<5% of total units

criteria.note: A three-column table, one column per AMI band, each with its own ladder. The plan does not say whether a project may claim in more than one band, so 45 is recorded as the maximum on the deepest band alone. Worth a reviewer's eye. Gross rent here includes the tenant portion plus the utility allowance.

criteria.heading: Redevelopment and revitalization
criteria.quote: Adaptive reuse projects are eligible for points under this scoring category
criteria.note: Awarded for any one of three conditions: a previously developed site, a QCT or city revitalization area contributing to a concerted community revitalization plan, or a site entirely within an Opportunity Zone. Rehabilitation of existing habitable housing does not qualify.

criteria.heading: Historic properties
criteria.quote: Properties that are on the National Register of Historic Places and receiving Historic Rehabilitation Tax Credits

criteria.heading: Service coordinator
criteria.quote: Service Coordinator for the residents of project
criteria.note: Must be available on site at least thirty minutes per project unit per month, by direct employment or contract. HUD's Service Coordinators in Multifamily Housing program is the stated basis.

criteria.heading: Design standards
criteria.quote: Projects may score points under only one Design Standard

tiers.tier_label: Elevator in each residential building
A separate outside main entrance for each unit

criteria.note: The two standards are alternatives worth 5 each; the plan states only one may be scored.

criteria.heading: Universal design
criteria.quote: Applicants seeking Project Standards points are required to provide a written statement

tiers.tier_label: All Project Standards implemented
Unit Standards in 10.00% to under 25.00% of units
Unit Standards in 5.00% to under 10.00% of units
Unit Standards in over 0.00% to under 5.00% of units
One point per universal design unit of two bedrooms or larger

criteria.note: Three components that add up to the 9-point maximum: project standards (3), a unit-standards ladder (up to 3), and up to 3 more for two-bedroom-or-larger universal design units. Requires an architect's written statement.

criteria.heading: Green communities
criteria.quote: Applicants must submit a written development plan outlining the integrated design approach

tiers.tier_label: Rehabilitation: LEED, Green Communities or ICC 700 certification
Rehabilitation: 17 Green Communities criteria
Rehabilitation: 10 Green Communities criteria
Not rehabilitation: LEED, Green Communities or ICC 700 certification
Not rehabilitation: 20 Green Communities criteria
Not rehabilitation: 15 Green Communities criteria
Not rehabilitation: 10 Green Communities criteria

criteria.note: Two separate ladders, one for rehabilitation and one for everything else; a project sits on one or the other.

criteria.heading: Rent rebate
criteria.quote: Commitment to set aside tenant-paid rent to assist in the purchase of a primary residence
criteria.note: At least 5% of tenant-paid rent rebated if the household moves to an owner-occupied primary residence within 30 days of vacating. HUD-assisted projects can instead earn the 2 points by committing to the Family Self-Sufficiency Program. Not available to applications seeking category K.

criteria.heading: Tenant ownership
criteria.quote: all residential buildings in the Project must be individually surveyed, platted, separate physical addresses
criteria.note: Requires a transfer plan, a future purchase price and homebuyer counselling. Not available to applications seeking category K.

criteria.heading: Family housing
criteria.quote: At least 20% of the low-income units are three-bedroom or larger
criteria.note: Not available to applications seeking category K.

criteria.heading: Housing for older persons
criteria.quote: Housing designed for and marketed to households consisting of individuals 55 years of age and over
criteria.note: Requires a community room with kitchen facilities free to tenants, and a marketing plan consistent with the Fair Housing Act's Housing for Older Persons exemption. Claiming this category rules out H, I and J.

criteria.heading: Preserve existing affordability
criteria.quote: A project proposing the acquisition and/or rehabilitation of a multifamily project currently assisted

tiers.tier_label: Asset preservation, at risk of loss within 30 months
Subsidy preservation
Asset preservation, at risk of loss within 60 months
LIHTC past its initial compliance period with waived extended use period
Transfer between parties with an identity of interest (maximum)

criteria.note: The plan caps a transfer between parties with an identity of interest at 4 points whichever route is used. Whether the asset and subsidy preservation routes can be combined is not stated; 8 is recorded as the maximum on one route.

criteria.heading: Committed leverage
criteria.quote: Applications which provide signed, firm commitments of funding source(s)

tiers.tier_label: Greater than 7.5% of total development costs
More than 5% but no more than 7.5% of total development costs
At least 1% but no more than 5% of total development costs
Twin-financed 9% LIHTC with 4% tax-exempt financing

criteria.note: The plan states a project may receive points under only one of these. Funds that require repayment, are temporary, or do not last the compliance period are excluded.

criteria.heading: Deduction for each missing threshold requirement
criteria.quote: a 2-point scoring deduction will be assessed for each missing Threshold Requirement
criteria.note: Applied per missing requirement, so the total deduction is unbounded in principle. An applicant granted an exemption from the Capital Needs Assessment requirement is not deducted for it.

criteria.heading: Fewer LIHTCs per unit
criteria.quote: the project requiring fewer LIHTCs per unit will be selected first

criteria.heading: Geographic location: at most two projects per city
criteria.quote: No more than two projects will be approved in any one city during a competitive application round
criteria.note: Lettered as a scoring category but carries no points: it is a limit on awards, not something an applicant earns or must satisfy. Recorded as a threshold for want of a closer kind; a project receiving an additional allocation under a prior year does not trigger the limit.

criteria.heading: Non-profit participation set-aside
criteria.quote: the Applicant must be a qualified non-profit organization
criteria.note: Ten percent of the state's allocation. The highest-ranking non-profit application takes the set-aside; further non-profit applications compete with for-profit ones. Ownership interest means at least a 50% general partner position.

criteria.heading: Native American set-aside
criteria.quote: Agency shall award the highest-scoring qualified application in the first application
criteria.note: For applications on North Dakota Indian reservations or tribal land, held in trust or fee simple, subject to the maximum credit limit.
